title: AI-based detection and size measurement of adenomas in the upper gastrointestinal tract in female and male patients with FAP
summary: The goal is to develop an artificial intelligence that supports the examiner in endoscopic examinations in distinguishing pathological changes in the mucous membrane from healthy mucous membrane.

interventions.name: Video signal recording during endoscopy, including gastroscopy and rectoscopy. Histological examination for the purpose of adenoma detection and identification of benign glandular cysts.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Indication for endoscopy
Consent to study participation
Exclusion criteria:
Not capable adults who cannot give informed consent are excluded from participating in the study.
